source_book: The Brand Relationship Spectrum — Aaker & Joachimsthaler (2000)

test_cases.prompt: We want to attach a subbrand to the master that stretches it into a new segment.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver; design subbrand-as-driver and check association transfer.

test_cases.prompt: Launch it Gillette Mach3 style where both the master and the new name lead.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver; set up a co-driver and run the quality-parity test.

test_cases.prompt: How do we extend the master with a subbrand without it just being a descriptor?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver; explain closeness rule and name the subbrand for freedom.

test_cases.prompt: Just endorse it with the parent; the parent should play only a minor driver role.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver; activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands (minor driver role).

test_cases.prompt: Make it a descriptive add-on under the master, full branded house.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver; activate aaker-relation-branded-house (descriptor, not named subbrand).

test_cases.prompt: We want a co-driver but the subbrand is clearly lower quality than our premium master.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver but warn: unequal quality tarnishes the prestige master; downgrade to endorser role (see aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls).

notes: ≥3 should_trigger + 2 should_not_trigger (sibling baits: aaker-relation-endorsed-brands, aaker-relation-branded-house) + 1 edge.
